guards: skills.manifest.json + .claude/skills/** + the shared audit references (all Category B)

poisonPill.why: One per-file sha edited while bundleVersion and schemaVersion are left intact, so a version-only comparison sees a fresh manifest. Until 2026-07-31 --check did exactly that and reported such a manifest FRESH — green having authenticated almost nothing. `mutate` rather than a snapshot fixture: bundleVersion changes on every skill edit, so a committed fixture would stop reproducing the versions-match condition and the pill would go red for reasons unrelated to the gate.

A hand-edit to the GENERATED copy rather than to skills/**. That copy is what every agent actually loads, so the edit takes effect immediately and then vanishes at the next regeneration — a change that works until it silently doesn't.

gates.stated: Every reference file has `summary:` YAML frontmatter that must byte-match

poisonPill.why: One consumer copy of a shared reference edited away from its canonical source. Two files required to stay byte-identical, and a human editing whichever one they happened to open, is exactly how they diverge.

AGENTS.md claimed skills:check enforced the 1024-char Copilot cap. It did not: on 2026-08-04 investigate (1257), explain (1152) and ux-lock (1062) were all over while skills:check exited 0 — a stated-but-unenforced gate. The pill overlays an over-length description so the gate must reject it; without check-skill-descriptions.mjs in the chain this exits 0 and the pill goes red. A fixture rather than a mutate: the budget is a property of the description TEXT, so an over-length file is the whole tamper and it stays reproducible as the real skills evolve.

gates.stated: indented under `description: |` it is description TEXT, parsed,

poisonPill.why: A `disable-model-invocation: true` indented two spaces inside `description: |` is description TEXT, not a key — parsed, valid, and inert, so the skill stays model-invocable while declaring it must not be. Measured live in a consumer 2026-09-03; the host listing showed the literal string as trailing prose, which was the only tell. The fixture is that consumer file's real frontmatter, not a hand-written probe: the broken and fixed forms differ only by leading whitespace, so a gate for a whitespace defect passes vacuously if the probe is wrong. Overlaid onto ship — the skill whose own header explains why self-invocation would be citing its own execution as consent.
